coverage.scope: The six fictional agenda items in this public demonstration file
exclusions: Real maintainer projects, people, deadlines, paths, and private execution state

items.title: Revision Claim Closeout
items.current_stage: The response structure is ready; one claim boundary still needs researcher judgment
items.next_step: Review the disputed claim, freeze what the evidence supports, and prepare the final response paragraph
items.self_action: Decide the final claim boundary and accept or reject the revised wording
items.ai_action: Compare the claim with cited evidence and prepare a bounded paragraph candidate
items.success_gate: The researcher accepts wording that does not exceed the evidence
items.merge_rule: Keep the revision obligation separate from new-paper ideas

zh-CN.title: 返修论断收尾
zh-CN.role_summary: 最终论断和提交决策负责人
zh-CN.current_stage: 回复结构已经完成，但仍有一条论断边界需要研究者判断
zh-CN.progress_label: 4 个有界里程碑中已完成 3 个
zh-CN.next_step: 核对争议论断，冻结证据实际支持的范围，并准备最终回复段落
zh-CN.self_action: 决定最终论断边界并接受或否决修订措辞
zh-CN.ai_action: 对照引用证据检查论断并准备有边界的候选段落
zh-CN.success_gate: 最终措辞由研究者接受且不超出证据
zh-CN.merge_rule: 把返修义务与新论文想法分开

items.title: Evaluation Pilot Decision
items.current_stage: A small pilot exists, but its decision evidence has not been reviewed
items.progress_label: Pilot design complete; evidence review and decision remain
items.next_step: Inspect the pilot evidence and make a go/no-go decision before expanding the experiment
items.self_action: Decide whether the signal justifies a larger experiment
items.ai_action: Summarize evidence, failure cases, and tradeoffs without making the final decision
items.success_gate: The researcher records a supported go/no-go judgment and next gate
items.merge_rule: Do not create a full project until the pilot gate passes

zh-CN.title: 评估 Pilot 判断
zh-CN.role_summary: Go/no-go 判断和实验范围负责人
zh-CN.current_stage: 最小 pilot 已存在，但决策证据尚未审阅
zh-CN.progress_label: Pilot 设计完成；仍需证据审阅和判断
zh-CN.next_step: 检查 pilot 证据，并在扩大实验前作出 go/no-go 判断
zh-CN.self_action: 判断信号是否足以支持更大实验
zh-CN.ai_action: 汇总证据、失败案例和取舍，但不替研究者作决定
zh-CN.success_gate: 研究者记录有证据的 go/no-go 判断和下一道 gate
zh-CN.merge_rule: Pilot 过门前不新建完整项目

items.title: Long-Form Draft
items.role_summary: Author and only person who can reopen the draft
items.activation_trigger: A specific reader, continuity, or publication issue is identified
items.current_stage: The current draft is preserved; no concrete reading problem justifies another pass
items.next_step: Reopen only after a specific reader, continuity, or publication trigger
items.self_action: Name the concrete trigger or keep the draft unchanged
items.ai_action: Preserve the current version and avoid manufacturing work
items.success_gate: A specific trigger exists or the author accepts the current version
items.merge_rule: Paused work stays owned but does not count as actively progressing

zh-CN.title: 长篇草稿
zh-CN.role_summary: 作者和唯一重开授权者
zh-CN.activation_trigger: 出现具体读感、连续性或发布问题
zh-CN.current_stage: 当前草稿保留；没有具体读者问题支持再次修改
zh-CN.next_step: 只有出现具体读感、连续性或发布触发时才重开
zh-CN.self_action: 指出具体触发，否则保持不变
zh-CN.ai_action: 保护当前版本，不制造新任务
zh-CN.success_gate: 出现具体触发，或作者接受当前版本
zh-CN.merge_rule: 暂停事项仍归用户所有，但不计入推进中

en.title: Long-Form Draft
en.role_summary: Author and only person who can reopen the draft
en.activation_trigger: A specific reader, continuity, or publication issue is identified
en.current_stage: The current draft is preserved; no concrete reading problem justifies another pass
en.next_step: Reopen only after a specific reader, continuity, or publication trigger
en.self_action: Name the concrete trigger or keep the draft unchanged
en.ai_action: Preserve the current version and avoid manufacturing work
en.success_gate: A specific trigger exists or the author accepts the current version
en.merge_rule: Paused work stays owned but does not count as actively progressing

items.title: Survey Scope Gate
items.role_summary: Decide whether the idea deserves an independent deliverable
items.current_stage: The topic exists, but independent reader value and overlap are unresolved
items.next_step: Compare the proposed survey with existing reviews and decide whether it deserves an independent manuscript
items.self_action: Decide whether the survey has a distinct question, audience, and contribution
items.ai_action: Prepare a short scope-and-overlap audit from public-safe sources selected by the user
items.success_gate: The researcher can state a distinct central question and reader value
items.merge_rule: Prefer reuse over a redundant manuscript

zh-CN.title: 综述范围门
zh-CN.role_summary: 决定想法是否值得成为独立交付物
zh-CN.current_stage: 主题已存在，但独立读者价值和重叠边界尚未解决
zh-CN.next_step: 比较候选综述与既有综述，并判断是否值得成为独立稿件
zh-CN.self_action: 判断是否有独立中心问题、目标读者和贡献
zh-CN.ai_action: 根据用户选择的公开安全来源准备简短 scope / overlap audit
zh-CN.success_gate: 研究者能够说明独立中心问题和读者价值
zh-CN.merge_rule: 优先复用，不制造重复稿件

en.title: Survey Scope Gate
en.role_summary: Decide whether the idea deserves an independent deliverable
en.current_stage: The topic exists, but independent reader value and overlap are unresolved
en.next_step: Compare the proposed survey with existing reviews and decide whether it deserves an independent manuscript
en.self_action: Decide whether the survey has a distinct question, audience, and contribution
en.ai_action: Prepare a short scope-and-overlap audit from public-safe sources selected by the user
en.success_gate: The researcher can state a distinct central question and reader value
en.merge_rule: Prefer reuse over a redundant manuscript

items.title: Collaborator Manuscript Review
items.role_summary: Review framing and evidence boundaries; no delivery ownership
items.current_stage: The collaborator owns the manuscript; a bounded review request is active
items.next_step: Return a claim-boundary review to the collaborator without taking over the manuscript
items.self_action: Review only the requested framing and evidence questions
items.ai_action: Prepare a concise review memo from user-selected public-safe sources
items.success_gate: The collaborator receives the bounded review and retains the final manuscript decision
items.merge_rule: Supporting work never enters the user's accountable-mainline count

zh-CN.title: 合作者稿件审阅
zh-CN.role_summary: 只审阅 framing 和证据边界，不承担稿件交付责任
zh-CN.current_stage: 合作者拥有稿件；当前有一项有边界的审阅请求
zh-CN.next_step: 向合作者返回 claim boundary 审阅，不接管稿件
zh-CN.self_action: 只判断请求范围内的 framing 和证据问题
zh-CN.ai_action: 根据用户选择的公开安全来源准备简短审阅备忘
zh-CN.success_gate: 合作者收到审阅并保留最终稿件决定
zh-CN.merge_rule: 协作事项永远不进入用户的主责主线数

items.title: Submitted Paper Under Review
items.role_summary: Respond only when the external decision arrives
items.activation_trigger: Official reviews, a rebuttal notice, an editorial decision, or a concrete author-team request arrives
items.current_stage: The current package has been submitted and no action is available
items.next_step: Wait for the external decision; when it arrives, verify the new responsibility and next action
items.self_action: Do not create speculative work while waiting
items.ai_action: Preserve the state boundary and prepare nothing until new evidence arrives
items.success_gate: A real external event creates a verified next action
items.merge_rule: Waiting does not count as active execution

zh-CN.title: 已投稿论文
zh-CN.role_summary: 只在外部决定到达后响应
zh-CN.activation_trigger: 收到 official reviews、rebuttal 通知、编辑决定或作者组明确请求
zh-CN.current_stage: 当前材料已提交，没有可执行动作
zh-CN.next_step: 等外部决定；到达后重新核对责任和唯一下一步
zh-CN.self_action: 等待期间不制造推测性工作
zh-CN.ai_action: 保持状态边界，新证据到达前不准备额外任务
zh-CN.success_gate: 真实外部事件产生经过核验的下一步
zh-CN.merge_rule: 等待事项不计入当前执行数
